status: PPO complete — clipped policy gradient validated on CartPole
key_finding: PPO with batched trajectories (16 per update), 10 epochs mini-batch SGD, and GAE (lambda=0.95) learns CartPole from 21→47 avg reward in 1000 episodes. Outperforms REINFORCE (10→7.4) by 6.3x. Key bug fix: single-trajectory updates gave no learning — PPO needs sample diversity per update for stable gradients. GAE combines TD(0) and MC: delta_t + (gamma*lambda)*delta_{t+1} + ... where lambda controls bias-variance tradeoff.
